semiconductor_relevance: High — J.E.T. Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of semiconductor cleaning equipment, crucial for the fabrication process.
summary: J.E.T. Co., Ltd specializes in the development, manufacture, and sales of semiconductor cleaning equipment, focusing on both batch-type and single-wafer systems. Their innovative technologies aim to enhance cleaning processes in semiconductor chip manufacturing, particularly in removing resist materials without harmful chemicals.

regional_presence.Japan: J.E.T. Co., Ltd is one of the top three semiconductor cleaning equipment manufacturers in Japan.
